title: Rav Natan bar Asya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Pesachim 52a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.52a.2) relates that he went from Bei Rav—Dikdukei Soferim reads “from Biram”—to Pumbedita on the second festival day of Shavuot. Rav Yosef excommunicated him. The Rif and Dikdukei Soferim read Mar Natan Asya.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The linked Pesachim has Rav Natan bar Asya travel from Bei Rav to Pumbedita on the second day of Shavuot and states that Rav Yosef excommunicated him. The supplied Hebrew has שאול where the linked witness has אזל, “went.”
מבירם means “from Biram,” an alternative to Bei Rav, not a place named Mavirom. Hyman attributes this reading to דק״ס, conventionally Dikdukei Soferim.
Hyman reports Mar Natan Asya in the Rif and Dikdukei Soferim, differing from the heading in title and by omitting bar. The heading’s full Rav and the cited Mar are both preserved.
